title: Waypoint Manager
description: A simple, chat-based waypoint mod for servers.
body:
# Waypoint Manager
A simple waypoint mod for Minecraft Java servers. Add and modify unlimited waypoints, easily navigate between them, and view all your waypoints at a glance with one simple, native command.  

## Features
- Allows admins or anyone with cheats to use waypoints
- Entirely based in the chat window
- Completely server-side
- Add, modify, list, and teleport to waypoints with the `/wp` command

## More Info
Information on contributing and building locally can be found in the [README](https://github.com/tomatopotato17265/waypoint-manager/blob/main/README.md).
